Black piping outlines the headboard of the Black Piping Contrast Bed with tailored precision, giving it a sharp finish that suits both contemporary and classic bedrooms. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Contrast black piping trim on the headboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £318.99; Small Double (4FT) £350.99; Double (4FT6) £363.99; King (5FT) £389.99; Super King (6FT) £461.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How is this different from the Black Piping Art Deco Bed?

This bed has a more classic headboard outline; the Black Piping Art Deco bed has an Art Deco-inspired shape.

Which sizes can I choose?

Single (3FT) to Super King (6FT), from £318.99.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Bumper Ottoman Storage Bed is a premium storage bed with a generously proportioned bumper-style headboard and a hydraulic gas lift ottoman base, giving you style and large under-bed storage in one complete bed. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £376.99 in Single 3ft to £584.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Bumper-style upholstered headboard
  • Hydraulic gas lift ottoman storage base
  • Large underbed storage compartment
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

  • Single (3FT): £376.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £454.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £480.99
  • King (5FT): £513.99
  • Super King (6FT): £584.99

Not sure which size you need? See our UK bed sizes guide.

Storage

The base lifts on a gas lift mechanism, giving easy access to the storage space underneath the mattress. Allow headroom above the bed and clear floor at the foot so the base can open fully. See how ottoman beds work.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, with custom fabric and colour options available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Browse our mattresses, such as the 1000 Pocket Sprung Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Compare the Mayfair Ottoman Divan Bed or browse all ottoman beds. Read ottoman bed vs divan bed if you are deciding.

How does the storage open?

The base lifts on a gas lift mechanism, giving easy access to the storage space underneath the mattress.

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available. Solid colours, stripes and two-tone finishes are available.

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
